reviews.title: Could be better
reviews.text: Missing banners and notifications. The developer has an opportunity to really make this a great app. Most notably, there are no banners or notifications for maintenance upcoming or past due. This should be such an easy thing to do. I do like the app interface, it is able to do all I need it to do. However, without the notices, I really can’t give a rating over 3 stars. I’ll gladly give a higher rating when these features are added.
